svg.title: A successful conversion to Tasmota: all 16 stages complete, then the report to share
svg.text: Converting a plug usually takes under 10 minutes. Some stages take a
minute or two with little to see - that's normal. Keep the plug plugged
in, and this computer awake, until the last stage says complete.
Stage 1 of 16 - Confirming prerequisites - Complete (0s)
Stage 2 of 16 - Validating local files - Complete (4s)
Stage 3 of 16 - Discovering the plug - Complete (7s)
Stage 4 of 16 - Querying Sonoff firmware - Complete (9s)
Stage 5 of 16 - Sending bridge firmware - Complete (20s)
Stage 6 of 16 - Backing up Sonoff firmware - Complete (14s)
Stage 7 of 16 - Installing interim firmware - Complete (19s)
Stage 8 of 16 - Preparing memory layout - Complete (32s)
Stage 9 of 16 - Updating the bootloader - Complete (3s)
Stage 10 of 16 - Verifying memory layout - Complete (2s)
Stage 11 of 16 - Staging startup firmware - Complete (29s)
Stage 12 of 16 - Committing memory layout - Complete (5s)
Stage 13 of 16 - Installing Tasmota - Complete (35s)
Stage 14 of 16 - Configuring Tasmota - Complete (31s)
Stage 15 of 16 - Installing Safeboot - Complete (33s)
Stage 16 of 16 - Verifying conversion - Complete (3s)
The plug is running official Tasmota...
Your plug: http://192.168.1.50/
